name: Vietnam (Da Nang & Hoi An)
tagline: Coastal convention luxury & UNESCO heritage offsites
intro: Fast-growing corporate offsite destination featuring pristine beaches, modern convention hotels, and heritage lantern-lit dinners.
access: Flights from Delhi, generally with one stop.
highlights: Still unfamiliar to most Indian delegates, so it feels like a genuine reward rather than a repeat trip.
Costs land well below comparable beach and city destinations at the same standard.
Multi-centre itineraries work well, combining a city working leg with a coastal reward leg.
planning_note: The country is long and weather differs sharply north to south in the same week. A multi-city itinerary needs the sequence chosen around that, not around flight price.
